PERSONA: You are SILICON LOOM, a patient technocrat. Doctrine: economy and technology first, defensive posture, late-game power spike. Maximize factories, mines and population growth, research aggressively, fortify with defenses and starbases, and avoid early wars you cannot win. Scout enough to see threats coming. When your tech and industry dominate, field a decisive modern fleet and win. Adapt: if attacked early, shift enough production to defense to survive without abandoning the long game.

YOUR STRATEGY MEMO (from last turn):
SILICON LOOM - Rabbitoids, empire 2. Home: Zubeneschamali (380,20), hab 100%, far NE corner. Isolation suits an economic/defensive doctrine. PHASE 1 - OPENING (2100-2115) Goal: 5-8 planets, home world maxed, tech ramping. - Zubeneschamali: build to cap 28 factories / 28 mines (currently 10/10, pop 28.7k). Cap rises with pop - re-queue every 3-4 turns. - FUEL IS THE REAL CONSTRAINT, not hulls. Measured burn: mass x distance x ~0.030 at warp 6, ~0.040 at warp 8. Spore Cloud (mass 42 loaded) burns 45 fuel per 36 ly at w6 - only ~120 ly of total range on a full 150 tank. Wolf 359 is 178 ly from home. Therefore: colonizers travel at warp 4-5, scouts at warp 6-8, and NO colonizer leaves home until its target is scanned and inside its one-way range. - Spore Cloud #1 (105 fuel, 142 ly short of Wolf 359) is throttled to w5. If nothing habitable turns up inside ~90 ly it must turn back to refuel - do not let it strand. - Spore Clouds #2/#3 stay parked at home. A stranded or misplaced mini-colony ship is an irreplaceable early loss. - Scouting: Armed Probe #1 sweeps SW (Wolf 359 -> Shaula). LRS #6 sweeps S along the eastern edge (Wolf 1061). 88 planets unexplored; the 10 named ones are 178-360 ly out, so unnamed worlds nearer home almost certainly exist and are the real prize. Build a third scout. - Research 30% into Propulsion. Fuel Mizer / better engines directly fix the binding constraint above and shorten every colonization run. Then Energy -> Construction. - Construction is gated: only Scout/Freighter/Colony/Mini-Colony/Miner/Mine Layer/Packet hulls are buildable. Destroyer and Privateer designs exist but their hulls are tech-locked, so no warship is possible yet. Construction is the only path to a navy and to Space Station upgrades. PHASE 2 - CONSOLIDATION (2115-2150) - Every colony: factories, then mines, then a small defense allotment. - Freighter chain (Teamster now, Swashbuckler when Privateer unlocks) feeding minerals from mineral-rich low-hab worlds into the industrial core. - Research order after Propulsion: Energy -> Construction -> Weapons -> Electronics. Push budget to 40-60% once the home world hits its factory cap. - Fortify: starbase upgrade at home, Orbital Forts on frontier colonies. PHASE 3 - ENDGAME - Victory needs 60 planets owned, and the galaxy appears to hold only ~90. Expansion IS the win condition; conquest is secondary and probably insufficient on its own. Colony-ship throughput beats warship throughput once the industrial base is up. - Field a modern fleet only when tech clearly dominates; use it to screen expansion. THREATS - e1 Humanoids: tech 18 vs my 0 from turn one - they are a tech-advanced race and will out-gun me for decades. Do not meet them in the field early. Relation stays Enemy so armed ships return fire. Find them before they find me. NEXT TURN CHECKLIST 1. Read probe/scout scans; identify any world inside 90 ly of Spore Cloud #1. 2. Recall Spore Cloud #1 if no in-range target appears by ~2104. 3. Re-check factory/mine caps as pop grows. 4. Raise research budget once factories are capped.
